entries.title: Welcome to Tempus!
entries.body: Welcome to the %%Tempus Region%%. You have arrived in @@Marino@@, a small town, in the midst of becoming a bustling hub of activity. On the beach, a @@distressed man@@ informs you that there are many stray, hungry Pokemon. Help them by adopting one, which will act as your %%Starter Pokemon%%, which is %%required to have before you are permitted to leave Marino%%.

entries.title: PokeCenter
entries.body: The %%PokeCenters%% in Tempus are Hospitals shared by Humans and Pokemon alike. %%Nurse Joy%% can be spoken with to heal your party up completely. @@Healing your Pokemon at a PokeCenter will also set your spawn point to that location.@@

entries.title: Nurse Joy Vans
entries.body: %%Healing Vans%% can be found out and about across the Tempus Region. They function the same way as PokeCenters however these vans @@do not set your spawn point@@ when they are used.

entries.title: Magiguy
entries.body: %%Magiguy%% is a utiltiy NPC found in all major locations in the @@Tempus Region@@. From here you can access any %%event rewards%% and %%Venture Quests%%.

entries.title: Gyms
entries.body: In Tempus, there are %%18 Gyms%% to challenge, one for each @@Pokemon Type@@. Each gym is located in a different location around the map. The more Gyms you beat, the %%higher the difficulty%% will be for subsequent Gyms.

entries.title: Level Caps
entries.body:
Beating Gyms also increases your %%Level Cap%%. In TempusMMO, there are %%19 Tiers%% total. Without beating any Gyms, players can train and use Pokemon up to Level 17. Catching Pokemon at higher levels is not restricted. Below are the Tiers for Levelling:
